# Miranda Faria

> Miranda Faria is a small software and design studio run by Eduardo Miranda Faria, based in Piumhi, Minas Gerais, Brazil. It builds custom business systems, websites, brand identity and AI automation, and two products: Apontador (time-clock and absenteeism analysis for factories in Brazil) and Eightyfive (attendance records for English language schools in Ireland). The site is bilingual: Portuguese at /pt and English at /en.

Miranda Faria works from diagnosis to delivery with one person accountable for the whole project. Systems are handed over in the client's name: the client runs them and keeps the data and access.

## Products

- [Apontador (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/apontador): reads the AFD file that Brazilian time clocks generate (Portaria MTP 671/2021, and the older Portaria 1510 layout) or the reports the time-keeping system exports (CSV, Excel, HTML, PDF). Shows absenteeism by day, sector and month, separating justified from unjustified absence, overtime and its cost, the daily absence sheet and labour-law (CLT) points of attention. Offer: a free diagnosis of one month of AFD. No need to change the time clock.
- [Apontador demo](https://apontador-demo.base44.app): public demo with fictional factories; visitors can import their own file, which is read in the browser.
- [Eightyfive (EN)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/eightyfive): attendance register for English language schools in Ireland listed on ILEP or authorised to use the TrustEd Ireland mark. Applies the 15-minute rule, records the class teacher's student count, flags 25% or more uncertified absence in the first six weeks, forecasts each student against the 85% attendance requirement and exports the full record.
- [Eightyfive demo](https://eightyfive.base44.app): demo with sample data.

## Answers and fact sheets (static pages, full text without JavaScript)

- [Fact sheet (EN)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/facts/) / [Ficha de fatos (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/fatos/): company details, services, products, how a project runs, contact, with FAQ. Only facts that are also on the site.
- [What the AFD is and how to measure factory absenteeism with it (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/guias/afd-absenteismo.html): AFD under Portaria MTP 671/2021, what can be measured, how the free diagnosis works, FAQ.
- [Attendance rules for English language schools in Ireland (EN)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/guides/ireland-attendance-rules.html): 15-minute rule, six-week 25% alert, 85% requirement, with the published sources, FAQ. Summary, not legal advice.

## Services

- [Systems and management (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/gestao) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/gestao): custom management systems (stock, sales, attendance, KPIs).
- [Development (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/desenvolvimento) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/desenvolvimento): websites, web systems and apps.
- [Design (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/design) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/design): brand identity and interface design.
- [Automation (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/automacao) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/automacao): AI and WhatsApp automation of repetitive work.
